title: Behoefte aan moderne vreemde talen bij oud-leerlingen van het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs 1987
authors: Lucassen, P., Oud-de Glas, M., Petersen, B., Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (primary investigator)
contributors: Instituut voor toegepaste sociale wetenschappen ( ITS ) * Nijmegen (data collector)
descriptions: Assessing need for learning foreign languages. Former pupils ( d ), teachers, schools, and business firms were asked about education in foreign languages, type of employment, use of foreign languages on the job / in leisure time / opinion about education in foreign languages. Background variables: basic characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education
